body:
Addressed in e6f730ad1: the re-pin branch no longer requires the first listed profile to carry a name. It pins `globalConfigName`, so a still-valid shared global selection is re-pinned even when listApiConfig[0] is a legacy nameless profile, instead of falling into the repair branch and being cleared with undefined. (Same fix as the F2 PR #1555, 5a87f9071 — this branch predates it.) Regression test pins the legacy shape: nameless first-listed entry plus a valid shared global → activation with the shared selection and no setValue("currentApiConfigName", undefined).

Validation: tsc --noEmit exit 0; 11 suites 611/611 on the merged tree (parallelMode, webviewMessageHandler, api-set-configuration, ClineProvider, sticky-profile, sticky-mode, importExport, switchModeTool, Task, ClineProvider.delegation, nested-delegation-resume); eslint --max-warnings=0 exit 0 on the touched files; no suppression count changes. Pushed with the main-first merge 9bf83e322.
